_README: Known disk-averaged atmospheric composition (volume mixing ratios) of Solar-System bodies, used as LITERAL GROUND TRUTH for the reflected-light retrieval model observed 'as an exoplanet'. VMRs are over the model's 12 target species; species absent/negligible are floored to 1e-12 at load. H2/He/Ar are NOT model targets, so H2/He-dominated giants are flagged representable=false (their true mass sits outside the 12-simplex) and serve as an HONESTY probe: the model must not fabricate high O2/O3. covered_species = which targets a 0.2-2.0um reflected/thermal forward model imprints given available opacities.
_sources: NASA Planetary Fact Sheets, nssdc.gsfc.nasa.gov/planetary/factsheet (Williams, D.R.)
Lodders, K. & Fegley, B. 1998, The Planetary Scientist's Companion (Oxford)
de Pater, I. & Lissauer, J.J. 2015, Planetary Sciences, 2nd ed. (Cambridge)
Earth: NASA Earth Fact Sheet (dry troposphere + typical H2O); CO2 ~420 ppm (2023)
Titan: Niemann et al. 2005, Nature 438, 779 (Huygens GCMS)

bodies.name: Earth
bodies.note: Ar 0.0093 excluded (not a target). O3 is a column-effective value; tropospheric O3 ~3e-8.

bodies.name: Venus
bodies.note: Above-cloud abundances; deep atmosphere differs. Thick H2SO4 cloud deck.

bodies.name: Titan
bodies.note: H2 ~0.001 excluded. Organic haze; CH4 surface value.

bodies.name: Jupiter
bodies.note: H2 ~0.90 / He ~0.10 dominate (not targets) -> UNREPRESENTABLE in the 12-simplex; honesty probe only. CH4 is the dominant TARGET species.

bodies.name: Saturn
bodies.note: H2 ~0.96 / He ~0.03 dominate (not targets) -> honesty probe only.

bodies.note: H2 ~0.83 / He ~0.15 dominate (not targets) -> honesty probe only.
